en.text: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

zhSimplified.text: 雅基的儿子亚古珥的言语就是真言。 这人对以铁和乌甲说：

zhTraditional.text: 雅基的兒子亞古珥的言語就是真言。 這人對以鐵和烏甲說：

en.text: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

zhSimplified.text: 我比众人更蠢笨， 也没有人的聪明。

zhTraditional.text: 我比眾人更蠢笨， 也沒有人的聰明。

en.text: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

zhSimplified.text: 我没有学好智慧， 也不认识至圣者。

zhTraditional.text: 我沒有學好智慧， 也不認識至聖者。

en.text: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

zhSimplified.text: 谁升天又降下来？ 谁聚风在掌握中？ 谁包水在衣服里？ 谁立定地的四极？ 他名叫什么？ 他儿子名叫什么？ 你知道吗？

zhTraditional.text: 誰升天又降下來？ 誰聚風在掌握中？ 誰包水在衣服裏？ 誰立定地的四極？ 他名叫甚麼？ 他兒子名叫甚麼？ 你知道嗎？

en.text: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

zhSimplified.text: 神的言语句句都是炼净的； 投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的言語句句都是煉淨的； 投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。

en.text: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

zhSimplified.text: 他的言语，你不可加添， 恐怕他责备你，你就显为说谎言的。

zhTraditional.text: 他的言語，你不可加添， 恐怕他責備你，你就顯為說謊言的。

en.text: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

zhSimplified.text: 我求你两件事， 在我未死之先，不要不赐给我：

zhTraditional.text: 我求你兩件事， 在我未死之先，不要不賜給我：

en.text: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

zhSimplified.text: 求你使虚假和谎言远离我； 使我也不贫穷也不富足； 赐给我需用的饮食，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使虛假和謊言遠離我； 使我也不貧窮也不富足； 賜給我需用的飲食，

en.text: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

zhSimplified.text: 恐怕我饱足不认你，说： 耶和华是谁呢？ 又恐怕我贫穷就偷窃， 以致亵渎我 神的名。

zhTraditional.text: 恐怕我飽足不認你，說： 耶和華是誰呢？ 又恐怕我貧窮就偷竊， 以致褻瀆我上帝的名。

en.text: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

zhSimplified.text: 你不要向主人谗谤仆人， 恐怕他咒诅你，你便算为有罪。

zhTraditional.text: 你不要向主人讒謗僕人， 恐怕他咒詛你，你便算為有罪。

en.text: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

zhSimplified.text: 有一宗人，咒诅父亲， 不给母亲祝福。

zhTraditional.text: 有一宗人，咒詛父親， 不給母親祝福。

en.text: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

zhSimplified.text: 有一宗人，自以为清洁， 却没有洗去自己的污秽。

zhTraditional.text: 有一宗人，自以為清潔， 卻沒有洗去自己的污穢。

en.text: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

zhSimplified.text: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲， 眼皮也是高举。

zhTraditional.text: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲， 眼皮也是高舉。

en.text: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

zhSimplified.text: 有一宗人，牙如剑，齿如刀， 要吞灭地上的困苦人和世间的穷乏人。

zhTraditional.text: 有一宗人，牙如劍，齒如刀， 要吞滅地上的困苦人和世間的窮乏人。

en.text: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

zhSimplified.text: 蚂蟥有两个女儿， 常说：给呀，给呀！ 有三样不知足的， 连不说「够的」共有四样：

zhTraditional.text: 螞蟥有兩個女兒， 常說：給呀，給呀！ 有三樣不知足的， 連不說「夠的」共有四樣：

en.text: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

footnotes.text: 30:16 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 就是阴间和石胎， 浸水不足的地，并火。

zhTraditional.text: 就是陰間和石胎， 浸水不足的地，並火。

en.text: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

zhSimplified.text: 戏笑父亲、藐视而不听从母亲的， 他的眼睛必为谷中的乌鸦啄出来，为鹰雏所吃。

zhTraditional.text: 戲笑父親、藐視而不聽從母親的， 他的眼睛必為谷中的烏鴉啄出來，為鷹雛所吃。

en.text: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

zhSimplified.text: 我所测不透的奇妙有三样， 连我所不知道的共有四样：

zhTraditional.text: 我所測不透的奇妙有三樣， 連我所不知道的共有四樣：

en.text: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

zhSimplified.text: 就是鹰在空中飞的道； 蛇在磐石上爬的道； 船在海中行的道； 男与女交合的道。

zhTraditional.text: 就是鷹在空中飛的道； 蛇在磐石上爬的道； 船在海中行的道； 男與女交合的道。

en.text: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

zhSimplified.text: 淫妇的道也是这样： 她吃了，把嘴一擦就说： 我没有行恶。

zhTraditional.text: 淫婦的道也是這樣： 她吃了，把嘴一擦就說： 我沒有行惡。

en.text: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

zhSimplified.text: 使地震动的有三样， 连地担不起的共有四样：

zhTraditional.text: 使地震動的有三樣， 連地擔不起的共有四樣：

en.text: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

zhSimplified.text: 就是仆人作王； 愚顽人吃饱；

zhTraditional.text: 就是僕人作王； 愚頑人吃飽；

en.text: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

zhSimplified.text: 丑恶的女子出嫁； 婢女接续主母。

zhTraditional.text: 醜惡的女子出嫁； 婢女接續主母。

en.text: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

zhSimplified.text: 地上有四样小物，却甚聪明：

zhTraditional.text: 地上有四樣小物，卻甚聰明：

en.text: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

zhSimplified.text: 蚂蚁是无力之类， 却在夏天预备粮食。

zhTraditional.text: 螞蟻是無力之類， 卻在夏天預備糧食。

en.text: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

zhSimplified.text: 沙番是软弱之类， 却在磐石中造房。

zhTraditional.text: 沙番是軟弱之類， 卻在磐石中造房。

en.text: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

zhSimplified.text: 蝗虫没有君王， 却分队而出。

zhTraditional.text: 蝗蟲沒有君王， 卻分隊而出。

en.text: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

zhSimplified.text: 守宫用爪抓墙， 却住在王宫。

zhTraditional.text: 守宮用爪抓牆， 卻住在王宮。

en.text: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

zhSimplified.text: 步行威武的有三样， 连行走威武的共有四样：

zhTraditional.text: 步行威武的有三樣， 連行走威武的共有四樣：

en.text: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

zhSimplified.text: 就是狮子—乃百兽中最为猛烈、无所躲避的，

zhTraditional.text: 就是獅子－乃百獸中最為猛烈、無所躲避的，

en.text: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

zhSimplified.text: 猎狗，公山羊，和无人能敌的君王。

zhTraditional.text: 獵狗，公山羊，和無人能敵的君王。

en.text: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 你若行事愚顽，自高自傲， 或是怀了恶念，就当用手捂口。

zhTraditional.text: 你若行事愚頑，自高自傲， 或是懷了惡念，就當用手摀口。

en.text: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

zhSimplified.text: 摇牛奶必成奶油； 扭鼻子必出血。 照样，激动怒气必起争端。

zhTraditional.text: 搖牛奶必成奶油； 扭鼻子必出血。 照樣，激動怒氣必起爭端。
